about.intro: Irwell Plumbing & Heating is a father and son business. We look after homes and rental properties across Salford, Manchester, Trafford and Bury.
story: Dave Hughes started Irwell Plumbing & Heating in 2012, after 10 years as an engineer with British Gas. He wanted to run things his own way, with honest prices, proper workmanship and real care for people's homes.
His son Ryan joined the business in 2019 as a heating engineer. Between them they fit, repair and service boilers, sort out central heating and handle everyday plumbing jobs.

We're still a small family team and we answer our own phones. When you call, you'll speak to someone who knows the job and can tell you when we'll be there. Many local letting agents rely on us for landlord gas safety certificates.
